svg.title: Playbook Runner architecture
svg.desc: The browser reaches the Caddy gateway on port 80, the only published port. The gateway sends /rpc, /api, /scalar and /openapi.json to the Hono backend on port 3000 and every other path to the Astro frontend on port 4321. The backend reads and writes PostgreSQL and calls the Ansible executor over gRPC through the gateway's router on port 50050, which forwards /run.* calls to the executor on port 50051; run events stream back on the same call. The executor connects to your hosts over SSH.
svg.text: Docker Compose stack. Only the gateway's port 80 is published; every other service stays on the internal network.

g.text: Connection, labelled with its protocol or route
gRPC inside the Compose network: the backend calls, run events stream back on the same call
